excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: <@552133098075193354> I think the problem is that the participants in this room are ignoring one of the axis of technical limitations (disk size) that need to be considered.  We could similarly ignore all CPUs less than 64 cores and IOPS less than 1M and figure out how much of a gas limit we can handle, but that isn't useful information.  We can trivially crank up the gas limit by just cranking the hardware requirements to server class, or DC clusters.  If we don't bound the discussion to some set of agreed hardware, it is a pointless discussion, even technically, I think.

no one is arguing for hardware spec's only possible in a datacenter and no one is treating these issues trivially. the whole point of this chat is to make gas increases rigorous, unlike all of the gas limit increases of the past
